svg.aria-label: Wolfenstein 3D casts one ray per screen column against the tile grid. The distance to the wall it hits sets the height of that column's wall slice
svg.title: Wolfenstein 3D casts one ray per screen column against the tile grid. The distance to the wall it hits sets the height of that column's wall slice
svg.text: The world is a grid of tiles. Each screen column casts one ray. The height of its slice depends on the distance to the wall.
a part of the 64 x 64 tile map, from above
the screen, with one slice per column, drawn from left to right
Light and dark faces show whether the ray crossed a vertical or a horizontal grid line.
Sprites are drawn after the walls, clipped against the distance stored for each column. Game time runs at 70 ticks a second.
